messages:
jamie park: FYI I opened a short playbook PR: label-mapping rollout + quickfixes for tenants moving from legacy_affinity -> tenant_labels. https://git/repo/pulls/5489
noah kim: Thanks. Can we include a tiny YAML before/after diff so customers can eyeball changes? Also call out SDK behavior when both fields present.
sylvia yu: adding the diff now. Quick note: SDKs before 0.9.4 silently accept legacy_affinity but ignore some subfields. I'll add an explicit compatibility table.

Old (legacy_affinity):
```yaml
tenant:
  name: acme
  legacy_affinity:
    region: us-west-2
    priority: 5
```
New (tenant_labels):
```yaml
tenant:
  name: acme
  tenant_labels:
    region: us-west-2
    priority: "5"
```

marta rios: can you also include a one-line CLI migration snippet? ops wants the exact flags for dry-run and backup.
jamie park: added this under Migration -> Quick commands:
```bash
# preview only
redwoodctl dedicated migrate-labels --input tenant.yaml --dry-run --backup backup-$(date +%F).yaml
# commit
redwoodctl dedicated migrate-labels --input tenant.yaml --apply --backup backup-$(date +%F).yaml
```
noah kim: great. Add note: requires CLI >=1.13.0 or SDK >=0.9.4 for true aliasing behavior. Older CLI will exit 0 but not apply.
sylvia yu: ops suggested we avoid the word "outage"; replaced with "brief placement wobble" and quantified: "observed placement wobble and elevated throttling ~30-60s in small test pools".
ops-bot: ops confirmation: conservative guidance OK. Recommend scheduling migrations during off-peak windows and keep rollback backup handy.
docbot: Lint check: missing cross-link to /handbook/dedicated/migration.md and missing changelog entry. Also flag: add an explicit rollback command in the playbook.
jamie park: adding rollback now:
```bash
# rollback labels from backup
redwoodctl dedicated restore-tenant --backup backup-2024-06-15.yaml
```
sylvia yu: I'll paste a small python SDK example for programmatic migration in the Quickstarts section:
```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
c = DedicatedClient()
# dry-run
c.tenants.migrate('t-acme', dry_run=True, backup='backup-2024-06-15.yaml')
# apply
c.tenants.migrate('t-acme', apply=True, backup='backup-2024-06-15.yaml')
```
noah kim: staging deploy queued. tagging docs-oncall for quick editorial pass.
staging-bot: deploy started: docs-staging -> /handbook/dedicated at 5198765500 by jamie park
noah kim: I'll run a tiny smoke: create a 2-node reserved pool, migrate a test tenant, send steady 50rps for 2m and watch throttles/5xx.
sylvia yu: added a short note about placement wobble: "placement wobble may trigger short-lived rescheduling; expect small increase in request latency while KV caches prime".
docbot: style nit: replace "wobble" with "placement wobble (brief reschedule)" and add link to observability panels.
jamie park: updated wording and added grafana panel links. merging after smoke test pass and one approval.
ops-bot: smoke test result: observed ~40s elevated throttling and a few p95 spikes during label propagation on 2-node pool; zero 5xx. Behavior matches playbook guidance. PASS.
noah kim: merging now. I'll follow up with a small PR to bump CLI/SDK min versions in quickstarts and add the changelog entry "docs: label-mapping rollout playbook + quickfixes". Thanks all. :tada:
